verdicts.note: Confirmed, and it stays open. It is why the inert tool-001 attempt cannot be explained, and it is one of the three reasons no honest upgrade of these two records exists: the tier deleted its stores in teardown at the time, so the directory the field would name is gone. Validating the field on read would reject both records and force a republish that nobody can perform. Both were retired instead — republished under today's admissibility policy, which is a recomputation over their own observations, so the comparator refuses them as baselines. A record written today carries the field, because publishRunRecord is the only writer and RunRecordInputs requires it.
